# Formula: # Measured floors, not guesses: entries are raised automatically when a build
# finishes, when a build is killed by the per-build cap, and when the job is
# cancelled mid-build. Anything whose padded estimate no longer fits a shared
# window is skipped (or deferred if something later needs it) and has to be
# built by a dedicated dispatch with only_package=<pkg>.
# llvm measured on CI: started at +8m, killed by the job timeout at 5h50m (>= 340m).
# 350m keeps it out of a shared run — that window is 5h plus a 20m publish reserve, so the
# weekly run declines llvm and the Mac builds it (scripts/mac_builder.sh). A dedicated
# only_package=llvm dispatch gives it the whole job (cap 345m after a 15m publish reserve),
# which the measured 340m fits by about three minutes — the one place CI can still do it,
# so it stays as the fallback rather than a flat never. llvm@22 has never been measured on
# CI; it stays at a number that keeps it on the Mac.
